## Trend Plots

The Trend tab (see [Mental Load](mental-load.qmd)) plots the pairwise ECE terms `lag_term(x, y)` over time, smoothed with a moving average, alongside the overall mean. It is a visual check for whether the covariance structure the estimator relies on is actually stable across the observation window, rather than drifting or jumping.

`plot_ece_terms(X, window = NULL)` (`R/plot-helpers.R`) automates this: for each column pair it draws the raw ECE term (gray), a rolling-window mean (blue), and the global mean the test actually uses (dashed red), faceted by pair.

```{R}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
devtools::load_all()
library(tidyverse)
```

For illustration, Scenario 2 (`L = 4`) induces a square-wave mean that flips sign every 4 observations:

```{R trend-scenario-2}
#| echo: false
params <- scenario(2, n = 1000, r = 0.5, L = 4)
X <- generate_data(params)
plot_ece_terms(X)
```
